name: ADAMAS ZERO II
source:
A parody game featuring Gun*am SEED DESTINY.
Features the coupling of Ne* and Kira, and Asl*n and Kira.
What destiny awaits the three?
This is the final volume of the novel adventure!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049411.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以《机动战士高达SEED DESTINY》为题材的恶搞游戏。
描写尼与基拉、阿斯兰与基拉的配对。
三人的命运将走向何方？
这是小说冒险游戏的最终卷！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049411.html]DLsite English[/url]]
